get.description: Runs SELECT, ASK, CONSTRUCT, or DESCRIBE against the participant-local snapshots. SPARQL Update and SERVICE are rejected. Result-producing queries require an outer LIMIT no greater than 1000. Query text is limited to 64 KiB and serialized output to 5 MiB.

200.description: SPARQL query result. The representation depends on the query form and Accept header.

400.description: The SPARQL query is missing, invalid, unbounded, or contains a forbidden operation.

401.description: A valid API-client token is required.

403.description: The API client does not have the required scope.

404.description: The operation or resource is not exposed by this participant.

413.description: The query or serialized result exceeds the configured limit.

503.description: Another SPARQL query is still occupying this replica.
